dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello, are you here to compete in The Crux Clash?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Yun
dialogues.text: You bet I am, have you put your names down yet?

response.speaker: Uncle Yun
response.text: Well, I'd have a look at the entrance criteria if I were you. They don't allow just anyone to take part.

response.speaker: Uncle Yun
response.text: The Clash is a comprehensive test of fighting ability. Anyone who turns up for show over skill is gonna get their butt handed to them.

response.speaker: Uncle Yun
response.text: Tsk, nobody wants to see that, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, we heard a rule about that. So Paimon's wondering... are you a renowned fighter?

response.speaker: Uncle Yun
response.text: Hahaha, me? Only a former runner-up in the Chihu Rock Freestyle Combat Summit! Oh yeah...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh-huh... Also, that doesn't sound like the most official tournament out there...

response.speaker: Uncle Yun
response.text: What!? You... Nonsense! Have you been living under a rock? It's been going on for years! There were plenty of competitors when I took part!

response.speaker: Uncle Yun
response.text: Not to mention, I've helped the Millelith catch Treasure Hoarders before! There were two of them trying to escape — I soon sorted them out.

response.speaker: Uncle Yun
response.text: They tried to sneak past me under the cover of darkness... Ha! They didn't know what hit 'em.

response.speaker: Uncle Yun
response.text: I planted a left hook on the skinnier one's face and sent him flying. Then, the big guy pulled out a knife!

response.speaker: Uncle Yun
response.text: I stood my ground, of course. A roundhouse kick sent the blade hurtling into a beam above us.

response.speaker: Uncle Yun
response.text: Hahaha, I told you! Unarmed, outnumbered two to one, but I still got the upper hand!

response.speaker: Uncle Yun
response.text: I'm not saying I came out completely unscathed of course, but the fact remains that I did manage to subdue the both of them... AND hand them over to the Millelith. I received quite the commendation! Oh yeah...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh-huh... But for us, even four or five Treasure Hoarders at a time is all in a day's work...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mm-hmm... Alright, we're gonna keep looking around.

response.speaker: Uncle Yun
response.text: I'll see you in the arena. Tsk, but I don't plan on losing to a pair of children any time soon!

choices.text: We just wanted to take a look around first.
